sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash live preview — Gemini API
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The exact endpoint specifications contain no total or active parameter count. They retain 131,072 input and 65,536 output tokens, text/audio output, thinking and synchronous function calling. The input summary omits video while migration instructions still describe video-frame handling.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash with Native Audio Capabilities (Flash Live) Model Card — March 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full reread of the original March 2026 Live card. Its model-dependencies section explicitly identifies Gemini 3 Pro as the base and refers architecture and training details to that card. No total, active, backbone or audio-component count is published. Visually inspected printed pages 4–6: charts report benchmark percentages; the 30B/A3B label belongs to compared Qwen3 Omni, not Gemini. Text/image/video/audio input, text/audio output and 128K context are explicit.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Audio (Flash Live, TTS) Model Card — April 2026 update
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full reread of the April 2026 Audio update. It separates Flash Live from Flash TTS and explicitly identifies Gemini 3 Pro as the base. Neither the Live variant nor any audio encoder/decoder component receives a numerical size. Model information and evaluation links provide no total or active count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card — May 2026 update
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 reread of the May 2026 Pro card. It names Gemini 3.1 Flash Live among models based on Gemini 3 Pro and describes sparse MoE routing. Neither the named base nor the Live variant has a numerical total, active count or expert/routing dimensions. Pro itself is explicitly not a modification or fine-tune of a prior model, so this source gives no earlier count-bearing base.

sources.title: Build real-time conversational agents with Gemini 3.1 Flash Live
sources.evidence: Reopened the March 26, 2026 original launch on October 27. It announces preview availability through the Live API using gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview and describes latency, audio reasoning and function-calling benchmarks. It supplies no total, active or audio-component parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: The March 26, 2026 entry explicitly records release of gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview for real-time dialogue and voice applications.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The service terms govern Gemini API use and prohibit extraction or replication of underlying models, including parameter weights. Along with the card's hosted distribution, this supports a proprietary classification rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Audio Model Card — September 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full review of the September 2026 Audio card. It identifies Gemini 3 Pro as the base for 3.8 audio models, without providing a numeric base size or retrospective 3.1 Flash Live count. Its later capabilities and thinking variants are not transferred to the older model.

sources.title: Gemini Audio — Live dialogue
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The current performance charts explicitly compare Gemini 3.1 Flash Live High/Minimal with 3.8 Live using speech quality, task accuracy and audio costs. Neither those charts nor the model-information table provides total or activated parameters. Thinking levels and benchmark scores do not establish a size.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card — October 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 review of the complete decoded October 2026 Argon card and its comparisons found no retrospective total or active count for Gemini 3.1 Flash Live. Argon is a new model, not an unchanged base for this Live variant.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.evidence: The current table schedules this endpoint's shutdown for November 17, 2026 and names Gemini 3.8 Live as its replacement. Its March 11 release date conflicts with the explicit March 26 release-note entry and launch announcement.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Audio Model Card, August 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-card check for later parameter disclosures. Live Translate, Transcribe and Transcribe Live explicitly depend on Gemini 3 Pro, but no total, active or audio-component count is published for that base or the earlier 3.1 Flash Live variant. This newer audio family is not treated as the same checkpoint.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report, October 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text exact-model and parameter check. No Gemini 3.1 Flash Live size disclosure was found; parameter mentions concern evaluation difficulty, protecting model weights and encoded knowledge rather than numerical model sizes.

name.note: Official name and exact preview endpoint match.

developer.note: Google DeepMind developed the model; Google is the catalog's developer grouping.

family.note: Flash-branded Gemini model; retain the catalog's Gemini Flash family key.

release_date.note: Retain the explicit public launch date corroborated by the exact-endpoint changelog. The deprecations table instead says March 11; no contemporaneous public release evidence for that earlier date was found.

open_weights.note: Hosted model under API service terms; the documented distribution provides no downloadable checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the Google-hosted model under Gemini API terms, not the documentation's separate content license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name/ID total-size, named-base and audio-component searches, original Live/Audio cards, the Pro base card and later primary comparisons found no supported nominal total. The explicit Gemini 3 Pro dependency is relevant lineage, but the base itself has no published count to inherit or scope to a backbone. No component count was found either. Null reflects absent numerical evidence, not an exact tensor-census requirement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-count searches and original/later comparison checks found no numerical per-token active count for Live or its named Pro base. Sparse routing is qualitative; expert dimensions and routing counts are not supplied. Benchmark percentages, thinking levels and the Qwen 30B/A3B comparison label do not establish a Gemini size. No audio-phase or component active count is published.

architecture.note: The exact Live cards explicitly designate Gemini 3 Pro as their architecture reference; that card specifies a sparse MoE Transformer. This is an explicit reference chain, not an inference from the Flash name.

context_window.note: Exact endpoint input-token limit; the separate output limit is 65,536.

modalities.note: Exact original and updated Live cards explicitly include video input and both output types. The current API summary row omits video, but its video-frame instructions remain; record this documentation inconsistency without discarding explicit capability evidence.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported with configurable levels.

tool_call.note: Function calling is supported, with synchronous execution only.

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer based on Gemini 3 Pro; neither the Live variant nor its named base has a published total or active parameter count in the reviewed sources. Exact Live specifications retain 131,072 input tokens and text/audio outputs. The current API input summary omits video, while both model cards and API migration instructions support it. March 26, 2026 is the explicit public launch and changelog date; the deprecations table inconsistently lists March 11. As of this audit, Google schedules shutdown for November 17, 2026; endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit on October 27, 2026 retains explicit null total and active counts after exact-name/ID and audio-component searches, original Live/Audio and named Pro base cards, the original launch, later audio comparisons and Argon safety review. The developer explicitly identifies the Pro dependency, but neither base nor Live/audio components have a supported published count. Original chart labels were visually checked and do not disclose Gemini sizes. All unrelated field assessments and corrections are preserved.
